building_upgrade._formula: cost = base * (from_level+1)^2 ; time = round((to_level^2 * duration / headquarter_level) / 3)

research_upgrade._formula: cost = base * (from_level+1)^2 ; time = round(round(to_level^2 * duration / research_lab_level) / 3)

troop_training._formula: cost = base * quantity ; time_per_unit = duration / training_building_level (NOT divided by 3, NOT rounded); batch = per_unit * quantity

troop_stats._source: library/Mob/Tropa/Abstract.php __construct (the defense *= 10 multiplier applies ONLY when game type is vendetta, so Space4k defense is NOT multiplied), getAtaque, getDefensa, getVelocidad, getCapacidad
troop_stats._formula: attack = floor((1 + sqrt(sum of levels of attack_research)/10) * base_attack); defense = floor((1 + sqrt(sum levels of defense_research)/10) * defense_raw) (defense_base == defense_raw, no multiplier); speed = round(base_speed*(1+sqrt(level speed_research)/10)); capacity = round(base_capacity*(1+sqrt(level enhanced_cargo_capacity)/10)). A research listed twice would count twice in the sum (no Space4k troop lists one twice).
troop_stats._note: Defense troops have no speed/capacity/salary: legacy getVelocidad() fatals (null research) -> null here; capacity reported null for defense troops (legacy round(null*x)=0).

production._source: library/Mob/Habitacion/Manager.php::getProduccion (real call, alcohol stock stubbed via Mob_Model_Edificio::getRecursos); tick = library/Mob/Controller/Plugin/Update.php:64-67 (int)ceil(prod/3600*dt)
production._note: Same legacy algorithm as Vendetta with Space4k rooms (Mob_Server::getNameHabRecurso): iron_mine->iron, lutinum_refinery->lutinum, drilling_rig->water, chemical_plant (bar slot) and enhanced_chemical_plant (smuggle slot) consume water to produce hydrogen. Quirks preserved: hydrogen production can be fractional or negative; when chemical_plant is satisfied from stock but drilling_rig output < its consumption, water production goes negative and enhanced_chemical_plant is fed getProduccionByConsumo(<negative prodAlcohol>); enhanced_chemical_plant starvation uses water production, not stock. water_stock 0 is treated as "no stock" (!empty check).

storage._formula: capacity = 10000 + 150000*level ; safe = capacity/10. iron_storage->iron, lutinum_storage->lutinum, hydrogen_tank->hydrogen, water_tank->water (Mob_Server::getDeposito)

honor._note: Legacy returns a string for exact table hits and a float otherwise; normalized to numbers here. For >100 buildings the honor level is NOT clamped to 8 before indexing.

distance_mission._formula: x(c,e) = (c-1)*17 + (e%17==0 ? 17 : frac(e/17)*17) - 1 ; y(b,e) = (b-1)*15 + ceil(e/17) - 1 ; distance = round(sqrt(dx^2+dy^2))*1000 ; duration = round(((d*3.3479)/vmax)^0.2 * 3600) ; salary = floor(d^0.8 * total_salary / 2512). Coordinates are coord1:coord2:coord3.
distance_mission._note: vmax = min speed of the fleet (application/forms/Misiones/Tropas.php:70-74); total_salary = sum(unit salary * count).

combat._source: library/Mob/Combat/Modificadores.php + Combat/Abstract.php (real class); input assembled like Combat/Manager.php:30-53
combat._note: troop_order is the PHP array insertion order (attacker troops first in Mob_Data order, then defender-only troops in Mob_Data order) and matters: the per-round loops iterate it and _getRival picks the LAST enemy with modifier > 1 in this order, else the largest stack. Stats in input are effective values from the real troop classes with every research at the given level. remaining counts are (int) casts of float totals; per-round counts may be fractional-free floats (emitted as ints).

cases.label: honor: both sides reduced (A: 50 bldg honor 8, D: 23 bldg honor 1)

loot._source: loot_legacy: REAL Mob_Combat_Manager::getRobo (library/Mob/Combat/Manager.php:152-191) invoked via reflection on a real Mob_Edificio (getRecursosDesprotegidos, Edificio.php:427-434) and a real Mob_Combat_Modificadores result
loot._legacy_formula: if defender has survivors -> 0. else for each r: loot[r] = min(round(unprot[r]*100/total*capacity/100), unprot[r]). The overflow redistribution code in getRobo is dead: $robo is overwritten by round($porcentaje*$capacidad/100) right after.
loot._target_algorithm: see lootTarget() in scripts/generate_test_vectors.php: iterative largest-remainder apportionment of capacity proportional to remaining unprotected stock, clamped per resource, clamped excess re-distributed until capacity or stock is exhausted; ties broken by order iron, lutinum, hydrogen, water. Never exceeds capacity; equals total unprotected when capacity >= total.

cases.label: rounding pushes legacy loot above capacity
smuggling research scales capacity; storage protects
